nora: Hi team — first week here. Trying to build the inference runtime on WSL2 with my laptop GPU (RTX 4070). Running `./scripts/build.sh --cuda --debug` and ptxas fails with a weird ValueError about an unsupported gpu arch. Anyone seen this? @paige

paige: welcome! :wave: Can you paste `nvcc --version`, `nvidia-smi`, and the exact ptxas snippet? WSL sometimes masks the toolkit-driver pairing.

nora: nvcc:
```
nvcc: NVIDIA (R) Cuda compiler driver
Cuda compilation tools, release 11.8, V11.8.89
```

nvidia-smi:
```
Driver Version: 535.65
GPU 0: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070
```

ptxas:
```
[ 9%] Building CUDA object src/runtime/CMakeFiles/runtime_cuda.dir/dispatch_kernels.cu.o
ptxas fatal   : ValueError: Unsupported gpu architecture 'compute_87'
CMake Error at cmake/FindCUDA.cmake:1455 (message):
  ptxas died with status 1
```

paige: 4070 is Lovelace-family (8.7/87). nvcc 11.8 may not know the literal token `compute_87`. Two practical options:
- use our dev docker image (recommended) which bundles CUDA 12.x, or
- force cmake to pass integer archs so the generator emits sm_87 codegen.

devex-bot: Suggestion: set `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` to an integer (e.g., 87) or an explicit code pair. Example: `-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=87` or `-DCMAKE_CUDA_FLAGS="-gencode=arch=compute_87,code=sm_87"`.

nora: tried `export CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=87` and clean build. That moved me past ptxas but hit a link error pulling in host /usr/local/cuda libs (system had CUDA 11 libs). Pulled the docker image `redwood/dev:cuda-12-4090` to match CI and rebuilt — success.

sam: nice. Two extra notes from infra: our CMake helper (cmake/Arch.cmake) prefers integer archs to keep flags portable across nvcc versions. If you want to support mixed machines, you can set `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=\"86;87;89\"` in your local env for multi-target builds, but that produces larger binaries.

paige: nora, please open a tiny PR to docs/dev-setup.md with the exact nvcc/nvidia-smi outputs, the failing ptxas snippet, and the one-liner fix you used (env or docker). Tag it `chore(dev): clarify lovelace wsl build` and ping dev-experience. We'll add a checklist item to onboarding.

infra-bot: FYI  recommended dev images: `redwood/dev:cuda-12` (generic) and `redwood/dev:cuda-12-4090` (4090/12.x). Use these for parity with CI.

nora: Will do the PR now. Thanks for the quick help everyone! :tada:
